answers.valueEn: Electric car with 100 kw motor. Broken front bumper. Protection layer on the entire car except the roof, front bumper, right and left sills, and trunk spoiler. Broken shield under the electric motor. One broken shield under the battery. Corrosion/salting from the small 70A battery. External work on the rear bumper sensor harness. Deep scratches on the rear right rim. Minor hit on the left sill. Chip on the hood. Slight depression in the rear metal panel.
